note: Demo taxonomy for Jinder. It is a small list that people made by hand for the Software Engineering, AI & Machine Learning and Data domains. It is not an official standard. ANZSCO codes with approximate=false are real codes. For approximate=true the code is the nearest real code. Certification names are public product names.

skillLevels.label: Beginner
skillLevels.meaning: You know the basic ideas. You need help with real tasks.

skillLevels.label: Working
skillLevels.meaning: You do simple tasks alone. You need help with hard ones.

skillLevels.label: Proficient
skillLevels.meaning: You do normal work alone, to a good standard.

skillLevels.label: Advanced
skillLevels.meaning: You solve hard problems and you guide other people.

skillLevels.label: Expert
skillLevels.meaning: You set the standard, design for others and teach the topic.
